messages.text:
"Create \"Starlight Fashion Adventure,\" a fully playable, colorful 3D open-world exploration and dress-up game for a 4–5-year-old girl who struggles with video games. Make it extremely easy, rewarding, magical, and fun without requiring reading.

WORLD: Build a beautiful interconnected fantasy world with a cute village, enchanted forest, sparkling beach, fairy garden, crystal cave, and princess castle. Include secret passages, hidden rooms, glowing objects, friendly animals, interactive decorations, and treasure chests. Use vibrant, polished cartoon graphics.

CHARACTERS: Start with a selection of 3 beautiful K-pop fantasy heroines visually inspired by Rumi, Mira, and Zoey from HUNTR/X (KPop Demon Hunters), or original similar designs. Give them distinctive hairstyles, colorful outfits, expressive animations, and a customizable wardrobe.

CONTROLS: Extremely simple! WASD/arrow keys or touchscreen joystick to move. Automatic third-person camera, one large interaction button, optional automatic jumping, and a dress-up button. Automatically collect nearby objects. No complicated controls, precise aiming, or manual camera movement. Support desktop and touchscreen.

GAMEPLAY: Freely explore, discover secrets, collect gems, stars, butterflies, flowers, magical keys, pet eggs, and fashion treasures. Open chests for random rewards. Make everything interactive: flowers bloom, animals react, doors open, and magical objects sparkle when touched. Add cheerful sound effects and rewarding animations.

FASHION: This is the main reward system! Unlock dresses, K-pop outfits, skirts, shoes, hairstyles, crowns, jewelry, wings, backpacks, and magical accessories. Allow unlimited mixing, matching, and saving favorite outfits. Collected items remain permanently unlocked.

RARITY: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary. Rare items have glowing colors; Epic items produce sparkles or animated effects; Legendary items have beautiful magical effects like butterfly followers, floating stars, rainbow wings, glowing footsteps, and musical notes. Make legendary treasures exciting discoveries.

PUZZLES: Include very easy visual puzzles: find 3 crystals to open a cave, touch 3 flowers to unlock a garden, discover a chest behind a waterfall, return a lost star to a fairy, or activate a magical tree. No reading, timers, penalties, or complicated sequences. Provide glowing hints.

PETS: Collect cute companion pets such as kittens, unicorns, baby dragons, puppies, and fairies. Pets automatically follow the player. Rare pets glow or leave sparkles.

EXTRAS: Add a one-button dance animation, magical fashion runway, photo mode, friendly NPCs offering simple rewards, secret treasure rooms, and a glowing butterfly helper that guides lost players toward interesting discoveries.

CHILD-FRIENDLY RULES: No combat, enemies, death, failure, pressure, purchases, or difficult missions. Use large picture-based buttons, minimal text, gentle sounds, and automatic progress saving. Reward curiosity frequently.

IMPORTANT: Build an ACTUAL WORKING GAME, not a mockup. Start with one polished interconnected village/forest/cave area, 3 selectable characters, 15 wearable fashion items, 20 collectibles, 5 treasure chests, 3 easy puzzles, 1 pet, working wardrobe, magical rarity effects, and save functionality. Prioritize functional gameplay and smooth controls before expanding.

CORE LOOP: Explore → Discover → Collect → Unlock Fashion → Dress Up → Explore More. Make wandering around enjoyable even without completing any objectives.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
